objectives.text: Count a group of up to 10 real objects by touching them one by one
Identify the number words and numerals from 1 to 10 in order
Explain that the final number counted tells how many objects are in total
Combine two groups of real objects to find the total sum up to 5
Explain how putting groups together makes a bigger group
Count groups of physical objects arranged in sets of five
Identify the number pattern when counting by fives up to one hundred
Explain why numbers in a counting by fives pattern always end in zero or five
Model two-digit addition problems using base-ten blocks to physically group tens and ones.
Explain why 10 ones must be traded or regrouped as 1 new ten.
Solve vertical addition equations that require regrouping in the ones place.
